ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is rectangle ABCD, with A and B on the upper side, and D and C on the lower side; AD is the vertical side, and the problem gives AD = 10 cm. The midpoint of the upper side is labeled M, and the midpoint of the lower side is labeled N. MN divides the whole rectangle into two identical left and right parts. Each half in the figure appears to be a square, with an inscribed circle inside, and each square has two diagonals drawn, forming an X shape. The gray regions are symmetrically distributed in the left and right squares. Reasoning: MN divides the rectangle into two congruent squares. Since the height of each square equals AD = 10 cm, the side length of each square is 10 cm, and the area is 10 × 10 = 100 cm². In one square, the two diagonals pass through the center of the circle and divide the inscribed circle into 4 equal 90° sectors; the gray sectors in the figure occupy 2 of them, so the gray part inside the circle is half of the area of the circle. At the same time, the diagonals and the circle also divide the four corner regions outside the circle into 4 congruent parts; the gray part outside the circle in the figure occupies 2 of them, so the gray part outside the circle is also half of the area outside the circle. Therefore, the gray area in one square is exactly half of the area of the whole square, namely 100 ÷ 2 = 50 cm². The left and right squares are the same, so the total gray area is 2 × 50 = 100 cm².

raw_record.question_text: In the rectangle $A B C D$ the side $A D$ is $10 \mathrm{~cm}$ long. $M$ and $N$ are the midpoints of the sides $A B$ and $C D$ respectively. How big is the grey area?

method.method_draft: Use a symmetry/halving argument on each half of the rectangle. From the diagram, MN splits rectangle ABCD into two congruent halves, and each half is a square containing an inscribed circle with both diagonals drawn. Since AD = 10 cm and the circle in each half is tangent to the top and bottom edges, each square has side 10 cm. In one square, the two diagonals pass through the circle center and divide the circle into four equal 90-degree sectors; the grey sectors are two of these four, so they make half the circle. The same diagonals and circle divide the area outside the circle into four congruent corner regions; the grey outside-circle regions are two of those four, so they make half the exterior. Therefore the grey area in one square is exactly half of the square area: 10^2/2 = 50 cm^2. There are two identical squares, so the total grey area is 2 · 50 = 100 cm^2.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是长方形 ABCD，A、B 在上边，D、C 在下边；AD 是竖直边，题给 AD = 10 cm。上边中点标为 M，下边中点标为 N，MN 把整个长方形分成左右两个相同的部分。图中每一半看起来都是一个正方形，里面各有一个内切圆，并且每个正方形画了两条对角线，形成 X 形。灰色区域在左右两个正方形中呈对称分布。

推理：MN 将长方形分成两个全等的正方形。因为每个正方形的高等于 AD = 10 cm，所以每个正方形的边长是 10 cm，面积是 10 × 10 = 100 cm²。

在一个正方形中，两条对角线经过圆心，把内切圆分成 4 个相等的 90° 扇形；图中灰色扇形占其中 2 个，所以灰色圆内部分是圆面积的一半。同时，对角线和圆也把圆外的四个角落区域分成 4 个全等部分；图中灰色圆外部分占其中 2 个，所以灰色圆外部分也是圆外面积的一半。因此，一个正方形中的灰色面积恰好是整个正方形面积的一半，即 100 ÷ 2 = 50 cm²。

左右两个正方形相同，所以总灰色面积是 2 × 50 = 100 cm²。
